references.IGBC: Indian Green Building Council - Green Homes v3 (2022)
references.GRIHA: Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment v2019
references.LEED: LEED v4.1 BD+C (Building Design and Construction)

recycled_content.name: Use of Recycled Content Materials
recycled_content.rationale: Using post-consumer plastic waste as aggregate demonstrates minimum 5% recycled content by cost

regional_materials.name: Use of Regional Materials
regional_materials.rationale: PET and HDPE are the dominant plastic waste streams in Indian urban areas - sourced regionally

low_heat_conductivity.name: Thermal Comfort and Insulation
low_heat_conductivity.rationale: Lightweight plastic-aggregate concrete with TC < 0.60 W/mK qualifies as thermal insulation material

embodied_energy_reduction.name: Reduction in Embodied Carbon vs Conventional
embodied_energy_reduction.rationale: >=10% reduction in embodied carbon vs conventional M20 concrete earns 1 point

waste_valorisation.name: Plastic Waste Valorisation
waste_valorisation.rationale: Diverting >=100 kg of plastic waste per m3 concrete qualifies as significant waste valorisation

building_product_disclosure.name: Building Product Disclosure and Optimization - Sourcing of Raw Materials
building_product_disclosure.rationale: >=10% plastic content demonstrates responsible sourcing of post-consumer waste

construction_waste.name: Construction and Demolition Waste Management
construction_waste.rationale: >=75 kg plastic diversion per m3 qualifies as significant waste diversion equivalent
